title: SimulationState
description: The structured state a simulation engine produces at one point in time, and the only thing AI agents interpret — they never invent this state (CLAUDE.md §5). Not implemented by a simulation engine yet; this defines the shape it must produce.

environmental_state.description: Wind, current, water level, etc. at this timestep — disaster-specific shape.

hazard_state.description: The disaster's own state — wave height, flood extent, wind field, slick position, etc.

affected_area.description: GeoJSON geometry (typically Polygon/MultiPolygon) of the currently affected extent.
